description: This file defines the AccessFlowStateMachineService class, which provides methods for managing workflow states, allowed actions, transitions, and role-based access control within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with data access objects (DAOs) and entity classes to perform CRUD operations and business logic related to workflow state machines.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for workflow state machine management, including role-based permissions, state transitions, and cache management within OrangeHRM.

methods.description: Lazy loader for AccessFlowStateMachineDao instance.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Fetch allowed workflow items for specific workflow, state, and role, utilizing cache.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Check if a specific action is permitted for a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Determine the next state based on current workflow, state, role, and action.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Retrieve all permitted recruitment application states for a role within a workflow.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Get states that can perform specific actions for a workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Fetch all workflow state machine records for a workflow and optional role.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Delete a specific workflow state machine record based on workflow, state, role, action, and resulting state.
